en.hubeali:
Is’haq said, 
‘Al-Hassan Bin Zareyf narrated to me saying, ‘

Two questions disturbed my chest. I wanted (to write) a letter regarding these two to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>). So I wrote asking him<sup>asws</sup> about Al-Qaim<sup>asws</sup> when he<sup>asws</sup> rises with what would he<sup>asws</sup> be judging and where would his gathering be in which he<sup>asws</sup> would be judging between the people. And I wanted to ask him<sup>asws</sup> about something (medication) for my alternating fever, but I neglected (writing) the news of the fever.

So the answer came: ‘You asked about Al-Qaims<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup>. So when he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> does rise, he<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> would judge between the people by his<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> knowledge like the judgment of Dawood<sup style="font-weight: normal">as</sup>. He<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> will not be asking for the proof. And you wanted to ask for (a cure) for the alternating fever but you forgot. So write in a paper and hang it upon the feverish person, so he would cool down by the Permission of Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup>, if Allah<sup style="font-weight: normal">azwj</sup> so Desires
[21:69] O fire! Be cool and a safety to Ibrahim
. So we hung it upon him what Abu Muhammad<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> had mentioned, so he would be cured’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ishaq has narrated from al-Aqra‘ who has said the following.

“I wrote to abu Muhammad (a.s.) asking him if Imams experience wet dreams? I said to myself after the letter had gone, “Wet dream is something Satanic, and Allah, the Most Holy, the Most High, has protected those whom He has given authority against such things.”

The answer came. “The conditions of the Imams when asleep is the same as when they are awake. Sleep does not change anything in them. Allah has given protection to those whom He has given authority from Satanic encounters as you spoke to yourself.”
